scope: First 12 semantic-authoring candidates of the planned 120 decisions; Greek language correction and independent review remain separate.
evidence_policy: Every claim is linked to a user message and one local evidence record.
Arithmetic outcomes are derived from operands and budgets.
List outcomes are derived by set difference between requested and previously supplied items.
State outcomes compare declared day, time, place, destination and party-size fields.
A null evidence value yields unresolved rather than false.
Earlier assistant mistakes used to teach recovery are train:false context.
No model self-assertion is treated as independent evidence.
